experiences.method_family: exact finite scalar/single-contour source closure under local SU(N) Haar elimination
experiences.failure_mode: a shared-link integration tangent between adjacent plaquette factors generates the concatenated rectangular Wilson-loop coordinate outside a marked vocabulary that omits that geometry
residual_signature: for SU(N), N>=3, normalized Haar orthogonality gives integral Tr(AU) Tr(U^dagger B) dU = Tr(AB)/N
center invariance kills integral Tr(AU) Tr(B^dagger U) dU for N>=3
therefore F'_0(A,B)=Tr(AB)/(2N) for F_t defined with exp(t Re Tr(U^dagger B))
for SU(3), A=P and B=P versus B=P^2 keep Tr(A)=Tr(B)=0 while Tr(AB) changes from 0 to 3, so the generated rectangle coordinate is not determined by the separate scalar traces
broken_assumptions: a deliberately tiny finite fundamental-plaquette/single-contour mark vocabulary remains exactly closed under local gauge integration
the geometry of a Wilson-loop mark can be compressed to an unchanged scalar coefficient through blocking/elimination
scope_conditions: normalized Haar integration over one shared link
two adjacent oriented plaquette factors in which the shared link appears with opposite orientation
first tangent at t=0 of a local interaction exp(t Re Tr(U^dagger B))
marked source vocabulary omits the concatenated rectangle loop or an equivalent coordinate capable of representing Tr(AB)
competing_diagnoses: genuine operator/geometry mixing under local gauge integration forces the concatenated contour into the marked state
the observed leakage is a strong-coupling/local-Haar feature whose coefficient or organization may differ in the weak-coupling Balaban RG regime, limiting transfer but not the exact local identity
a full block transformation may reorganize or cancel some local generated terms, so the local result cannot be promoted to a Balaban-wide impossibility without a block-specific derivation
experiences.selected_diagnosis: within the registered local Haar scope, the marked representation is too small: exact gauge integration generates a new concatenated-loop geometry that is not recoverable from the omitted scalar/single-contour coordinates; the broader method-level diagnosis remains scoped and is not promoted to a Balaban-wide impossibility
evidence_pointers: R. A. Brandt, F. Neri, M.-a. Sato, Phys. Rev. D 24 (1981) 879, DOI:10.1103/PhysRevD.24.879
experiences.falsifier_or_attempt: evaluate the exact one-link Haar contraction for adjacent plaquette source/action factors and use an SU(3) permutation-matrix pair as a planted witness against reconstruction of Tr(AB) from the separate scalar traces
experiences.observed_result: the exact derivative contains Tr(AB)/(2N), and the SU(3) witness changes this generated coordinate while holding the separate traces fixed; exact closure of the tiny registered vocabulary is therefore false
local_repair_attempts: add concatenated-contour and geometry labels rather than patching only scalar coefficients
prefer a graded/quasi-local marked loop/polymer or spin-network space with an explicit weighted support/complexity norm and typed irrelevant remainder
test the actual weak-coupling Balaban block before transferring the local impossibility beyond its registered scope
carry reflection-half-space buffer coordinates explicitly so support growth and positivity are audited separately

experiences.method_family: infer the full transfer-matrix spectral gap from exponential decay of a restricted source family
experiences.failure_mode: the source-generated sector can be spectrally blind to a lower-energy excitation
residual_signature: T=diag(1,1/2,1/4) is positive self-adjoint with true first excited ratio 1/2
the tested source satisfies A Omega=e2 and has exact correlator C_A(n)=(1/4)^n
the source-visible decay rate log 4 is strictly larger than the true full gap log 2
broken_assumptions: fast decay of the tested correlators certifies that no lower-energy state exists outside their generated cyclic subspace
scope_conditions: source families whose vacuum-generated span has not been proved dense/cyclic in the physical excited-state space
competing_diagnoses: the decay-to-gap inference is valid only within the tested source-generated spectral subspace
a kinematically complete source basis repairs visibility but still requires a common uniform decay rate over that complete family
Yang-Mills-specific gauge constraints could alter which source family is physically natural but do not repair the abstract logical gap by themselves
experiences.selected_diagnosis: loss of spectral visibility: a non-dense source-generated sector can omit the true first excitation, so restricted-source clustering does not determine the full transfer gap
experiences.falsifier_or_attempt: use an exact three-state positive transfer matrix and a vacuum source orthogonal to the lower excited state
experiences.observed_result: the tested correlator decays exactly as 4^{-n} even though an orthogonal state with transfer eigenvalue 1/2 gives the smaller full spectral gap log 2
local_repair_attempts: split G4 into G4a kinematic source completeness and G4b a common decay-rate theorem over a complete/dense source family
bind later lattice Yang-Mills arguments to an explicit fixed-lattice gauge-invariant basis before inferring a full gap
do not import continuum local-algebra cyclicity before continuum Yang-Mills existence is established

links.rationale: Both warn that an aggressively compressed finite source representation can omit a load-bearing coordinate, but one is local geometry/operator proliferation and the other spectral invisibility; neither is a global blacklist.
